entries.1725eee1abe2b3d5: Sales of Own and Other Brands' Products (Co-Creation and Self-Creation Value-Up)
entries.25bf2185768a28c0: This is a service that provides support to brands and manufacturers specializing in the entire EC value chain or individual functions, from strategy planning to site operation, marketing, logistics and customer service. Revenue is mainly stock revenue based on contract periods of, in principle, 12 months, and in the fiscal year ended March 2026 it accounted for 92.9% of this service's revenue. Revenue from external customers was ¥3,165 million.
entries.38d8e2bd7beb1ba9: This is a service in which the company acts as an EC business partner for brands and manufacturers, handling the operation of their official EC business in full. It purchases products, bears inventory risk itself, and handles everything from sales, customer service and delivery across domestic EC channels. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥13,091 million.
entries.670d9eae4a1900fd: Official Brand EC Operation Agency (Collaborative Brand Partners)
entries.67c5c7b012e67551: This is a service that sells the company's own brands, brands acquired through M&A or investment, and other companies' brands for which it has obtained sales agency rights directly to consumers through each EC channel.
entries.79514425774fcf9f: This is a service that develops, plans and operates the live commerce platform "Peace you LIVE" and the members-only invitation community "ICE CREAM" for the Chinese market. It is handled by subsidiary Pīsuyū Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥199 million.

entries.c6d046ac00ff6e88: This is the single business of the company's group. It consists of the company, 4 consolidated subsidiaries and 2 non-consolidated subsidiaries.
